response.quote_a: In order to enable the Heads of the Departments / Secretariat Departments to incur expenditure with immediate effect until the issue of CBRO by the Finance Department, Government hereby authorize the departments to in cur expenditure not exceeding the amount utilised by the Department in the month of April 2015 from the budget allocation for the year 2016 -17 under each head of account in respect of Non Plan and ongoing schemes under State Development Plan.
response.quote_b: No expenditure shall be incurred until the CBRO is issued.
response.explanation: Document A permits departments to incur certain expenditures before the CBRO is issued, whereas Document B prohibits any expenditure until the CBRO is issued.
